name: constraint-bounds-pass
$comment: Declarative field constraints, inclusive boundaries: min/max on number AND int64 (decimal-string wire form) and minLength/maxLength/pattern on string all PASS exactly at the edge — min <= v <= max is inclusive on both ends, length counts are inclusive, and the pattern is an unanchored search (^...$ here makes it effectively full-match; the anchors are part of the declared pattern, not engine behavior). Values at every boundary seed cleanly and the read path is unchanged (constraints are write-path only).
